messages:
devon: Heads-up — draft proposal for eviction thresholds + rollout gating for the routing/policy layer. Want quick sync before next PM review. TL;DR: per-tenant soft eviction at 95th pct CPU/queued tokens + hard eviction at 99.5pct or sustained 60s overload. Canary rollouts with 'degrade-first' path. Comments?

maria: love the framing. can we tie soft eviction to customer tier? free/seed vs enterprise different thresholds.

sam: agree. also need SLO-driven thresholds per model-size (long-seq vs short-seq). a 95% for 32k tokens is different cost than 2k.

anya: +1 to tier + model class. we should also add cooldown windows so tenants don't thrash in/out.

devon: good point. thinking cooldown of 5m after soft eviction before re-allow. hard eviction requires manual or 10m cooldown.

luca: ops question — how visible will this be in Console? Need per-tenant telemetry + alerting with suggested mitigations.

devon: plan is Console will show eviction events, reason codes, recent QPS/latency. will add 'mitigation hints'.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: policy-service v2.3.0 to staging at 2026-03-25T18:00Z

maria: for rollout gating we propose: rollout phases = {canary(1%), ramp(10%), broad(100%)} + automated backoff on error-rate > 2x baseline OR latency p99 increase > 30%.

sam: suggest also add 'degrade-first' path — instead of full rollback, route to cheaper quantized model variant or increase batch size for affected tenants. less user-visible.

devon: here's a draft policy snippet (pseudoyaml):

```yaml
policy:
  soft_eviction:
    thresholds:
      default: 0.95
      enterprise: 0.98
    cooldown: 300  # seconds
  hard_eviction:
    threshold: 0.995
    sustained: 60  # seconds
  rollout:
    phases: [canary, ramp, broad]
    canary_pct: 0.01
    ramp_pct: 0.10
    backoff_criteria:
      error_rate_multiplier: 2.0
      p99_latency_increase_pct: 30
    degrade_first: true
```

anya: small nit — use absolute limits for sustained tokens in flight too. maybe limit = 5e6 tokens per tenant for soft eviction.

devon: added. also need launch criteria: telemetry hooks, alerting, docs, customer comms, and a dry-run mode for 2 weeks. checklist:
- telemetry + metrics
- canary in staging
- dry-run in prod (no action, just logs) 2w
- enable soft_eviction 10% of tenants
- validate rollback paths
- customer comms for enterprise accounts

luca: can ops get a playbook for manual interventions? yes please.

maria: prioritize enterprise tier + regulated customers for manual allowlist, also provide SLA exceptions process.

sam: engineering estimate: policy-service changes 2w, console changes 1.5w, rollout automation 1w, docs & playbook 1w. total ~6.5w.

devon: sounds right. propose ship plan: Q2 week 3 staging canary -> Q2 week 5 dry-run prod -> Q3 week 1 gated enable.

maria: customer asks: partnerX needs earlier exception path, could we do customer-specific override by next quarter?

devon: we can scope a simple 'override ticket id' allowlist. add to backlog and try to prioritize after dry-run.

anya: action items: devon to update RFC with thresholds + YAML, sam to prototype degrade-first routing, luca to draft playbook, maria to coordinate customer comms.

devon: I'll update RFC by EOD Fri. thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: 👍

luca: thanks!

infra-bot: deploy completed: policy-service v2.3.0 -> staging at 2026-03-25T18:04Z (ok)
